17849.summary: Alphadia Genesis is the first JRPG from acclaimed developers KEMCO to be released on Steam. The story chronicles an epic adventure with Fray and his investigative team from the Archleign Kingdom as they set out to solve a mysterious murder case in a nearby city.

18849.summary: On the desolate moon of Lorian V, a long-dormant Deadsuit awakens from slumber. Journey beneath the surface on an atmospheric 2D adventure of self-discovery, ancient mysteries, and cosmic terror. Explore winding caverns and acquire new abilities to unearth this alien world’s long-buried secrets.

19449.summary:
DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 builds upon the highly popular DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE with enhanced graphics that will further immerse players into the largest and most detailed Dragon Ball world ever developed.

DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 2 will deliver a new hub city and the most character customization choices to date among a multitude of new features and special upgrades.
19449.storyline: In the bustling hub of Conton City, watched over by the mysterious Supreme Kai of Time and her bird Tokitoki, an elite group known as the Time Patrol guards the flow of history itself. The player becomes one of these patrollers, a custom warrior of one of the Dragon Ball universe's storied races, tasked by the Elder Kai with mending dangerous distortions rippling through time. Someone is meddling with the past, empowering old villains and twisting the outcomes of legendary battles. Behind these changes lurk the scheming sorceress Towa and her monstrous creation Mira, who draw dark power from altered timelines to further their own sinister ends. Journeying alongside heroes like Goku, Vegeta, and Future Trunks across iconic eras of the saga, the patroller must set right each corrupted moment before history unravels. As the meddling grows bolder, the fate of every timeline rests on the shoulders of a single rising warrior.

28249.summary:
You'll get caught in the night - NIGHT TRAP!

Originally developed by Digital Pictures in 1987 and released in 1992, Night Trap has been completely rebuilt, bringing it to a level of video quality never before seen.

Night Trap tells the story of five teenage girls spending the weekend at the Martin home. As a member of the Special Control Attack Team, your job is to monitor the home and protect the girls using an intricate system of cameras and traps as it is being invaded by vampires.

Night Trap - 25th Anniversary Edition also includes new features such as deleted scenes, two documentaries, the all-new Theater that allows you to watch all story-related videos uninterrupted, a new mode called Survivor that will test your skills at trapping intruders and behind the scenes production images. For the first time ever, the unreleased prototype Scene Of The Crime will be fully playable and included with Night Trap - 25th Anniversary Edition.
28249.storyline: The player plays as an agent of the Special Control Attack Team (S.C.A.T.), swapping between various security cameras trying to save the guests in the Martin home from vampire like creatures called "Augers". To do this, the player controls a series of traps that will kill the creatures if they are set off at the right time and if the agent is watching the room the Augers show up in. Depending on the player's timing and the colors of the cameras the player can either succeed or fail. The player can also reach different endings depending on how many Augers and Martin family members are captured.

33449.summary:
Do you have what it takes to join the Royal Academy of Magi in a new Highschool Romance story.
After attempting a dark ritual which increases innate magical ability, but transforms your body.

36649.summary: El Presidente is back! Prove yourself once again as a feared dictator or peace-loving statesman on the island state of Tropico and shape the fate of your very own banana republic through four distinctive eras.

36749.summary: Guide a mother and her child as they embark on a journey through magical architecture, discovering illusionary pathways and delightful puzzles as you learn the secrets of the Sacred Geometry.
36749.storyline: In this meditative and calming puzzle game, follow the heart warming story of Ro in her journey through motherhood.

39749.summary: Enter The House of Da Vinci, a new must-try 3D puzzle adventure game. Solve mechanical puzzles, discover hidden objects, escape from rooms and dive into the authentic atmosphere of the Renaissance. Use all your wits to find out what's behind your master's disappearance.
39749.storyline: Set in Florence, Italy during the height of the Renaissance, the story casts the player as a devoted apprentice to the legendary inventor and artist Leonardo da Vinci. When the great master mysteriously vanishes, the apprentice begins searching for him, starting within the walls of Da Vinci's own house. Room by room, they must unravel an intricate web of ingenious mechanical contraptions and physics-based puzzles, reverse engineering the genius's inventions to uncover clues about where he has gone. Along the way, the apprentice discovers two extraordinary lenses granting supernatural sight: one reveals hidden codes and secrets concealed in plain view, while the other peers into the past to witness events that have already unfolded. Guided by cryptic letters left behind by Da Vinci, and shadowed by unseen adversaries with their own designs, the apprentice ventures deeper into the master's world of art, machinery, and secrets in pursuit of the truth.

56149.summary: Take actor Danny Trejo on a journey to collect tacos and taco ingredients.

105049.summary:
The world is in ruins. Only a remnant of mankind remains, hunted to near extinction by horrors from another world. As one of the few survivors left, you will venture into portals to fantastic realms to gather the resources and firepower needed to fight back and retake what was lost.

Remnant: From the Ashes is a third-person survival-action game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mythical creatures. The game provides players and up to three of their friends with a unique, customizable gameplay experience filled with intense shooting and melee combat, gear and weapon crafting, character progression and dynamically-generated levels that offer an infinite number of ways to explore and take on deadly monsters and epic bosses.
105049.storyline: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. Humanity is struggling to survive, but they possess the technology to open portals to other realms and alternate realities. They must travel through these portals to uncover the mystery of where the evil came from, scavenge resources to stay alive, and fight back to carve out a foothold for mankind to rebuild...

115049.summary: In The Savior's Gang, the player controls The Savior, a powerful entity that is crucified and trapped between the world of mortals and heaven. This unfair death triggers the wrath of his father, an almighty pidgeon, which unleashes a series of traps, disasters and dangers all over the world. The Savior must negotiate with his Father to stop these catastrophes and save only his worshippers from all these evils and, try to get out of limbo and recover his power. To achieve his goals, he will have his good friend Stan (he hates to be called Satan) and the intermediation of his Mother and Stepfather.

116849.summary: Follow along with the adventures of Dulce as she finds new friends, new fun, and maybe even romance in the world of Dragon Connection, a hot new augmented reality mobile game. A, short and sweet free all-ages GxG visual novel featuring cute girls, friendship, and romance!

119249.summary:
Enter an ever-changing world full of legendary encounters and stories. Craft your cards, assemble the perfect deck and defeat the Roguebook itself... or die trying.

Roguebook is a single-player roguelike deck-builder that takes place in a procedurally generated world.

119349.summary: Discover a unique combination of branching stories, innovative combat, and classic RPG gameplay in Cris Tales’ exciting and unforgettable exploration of how our actions echo through time. Join the newly awakened Time Mage, Crisbell, and her fantastical companions in a fantasy world facing a grim future. The powerful Time Empress and her forces threaten to bring about a cataclysm tearing apart Crystallis and the other four Kingdoms of the region.
119349.storyline: To stop the Time Empress and rewrite the future of the land, you will embark on a harrowing journey across the kingdoms, meeting and recruiting powerful allies to aid in the fight. Master their abilities and Crisbell’s unique Time Magic to overcome mighty foes: send them into the past to face their weaker, younger selves; to the future where they’ve succumbed to all the damage of a poison applied in the present; or create your own strategies in this one-of-a-kind combat system. Your choices in this world will have far-reaching consequences for everyone you meet. Peer into the past, act in the present, and watch as your choices dynamically change the future -- all on one screen as you play!

122049.summary: In this exploration/adventure game, you play Frankenstein's Creature, a being with no memory and past. At the start of the game you know neither Good nor Evil, you are a blank soul in an adult body. By exploring the world, you will experience your emotions, develop and write the first pages of your story. When confronted with mankind, there will be no way to escape the question of your origins: Who abandoned you in this world? Hunted by this question The Wanderer: Frankenstein's Creature will take you on an adventure throughout Europe. Your experiences - some brutal and tragic, others joyful - as well as your choices, will bring you closer to the truth with every step. But will you be ready to face this truth?

122449.summary: Vanquish your foes with a single strike in 1v1 weapon-based fighter Die by the Blade. Dive into a samuraipunk world and wield a range of traditional Japanese weapons to determine your moveset. Outwit your opponent in intense, tactical battles and master the art of the one-hit kill!
122449.storyline:
Die by the Blade does not use the concept of healthpoints and healthbar. Just as in real life, any hit delivered is painful. The game is built on a realistic battle system which emphasizes weapon positioning for defending yourself. A clean hit to the any vital area will result in an instant death. This system will help you to absorb your mistakes and give you a chance to mount a comeback needed for victory.
Since every fight in Die by the Blade has different feel and difficulty, you can choose how many lives will be part of the round and then you can easily adapt to the difficulty of each fight for yourself. One to three lives result in high tension fights which might be sometimes based on luck and one random win can affect the whole result of the match. Five to seven lives fights are a bit more relaxed.

127749.summary: Manage your own bunny park! Give snacks and toys to your bunnies. Improve and decorate your park to increase its popularity and collect all the bunnies!

132449.summary: The Outbound Ghost is an adventure RPG about helping ghosts ascend to the afterlife. Battle the past using figments of your personality. Craft badges to earn abilities. Explore a town of troubled spooks and discover life can be tough, even when you're dead.
132449.storyline: In the world of The Outbound Ghost, ghosts are the embodiment of regret. Most people go to the afterlife after dying, yet those who were unhappy with their previous lives become ghosts and are forced to haunt the Earth until they right their wrongs. Of course, this is not always possible since doing this as a ghost is orders of magnitude harder than when you are a human. However, some manage to do this and are able to spend the rest of their deaths in the afterlife. In The Outbound Ghost, your task is to help others fix or come to terms with their past lives so that they can enjoy the pleasures of eternal bliss. You must achieve that for yourself too, but it's not so easy to mend the mistakes of your past life when you don't even remember them.

133149.summary: Post Void is a hypnotic scramble of early first-person shooter design that values speed above all else. Keep your head full and reach the end; kill what you can to see it mend; get the high score or try again.

137849.summary:
Wizodd is a dungeon crawler roguelike game where you find various equipment and upgrades while encountering dangerous monsters and bosses to advance down to the lower floors.

Inspired by The Binding of Isaac but without blood and more magic. This game is easy to play and simple to get the mechanics, all you do is find monsters and make them explode in different ways, and as you improve on Wizodd, you get to be stronger, dodge the various traps and clear levels more quickly.

138949.summary: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered is a PlayStation 5 and PC version of the open-world action-adventure game originally released for PlayStation 4 in 2018. Players control an experienced Peter Parker as he swings through a detailed recreation of Manhattan, fights crime using acrobatic combat, stealth, and web-based abilities, and navigates a story that intertwines his personal life with his responsibilities as Spider-Man. The remaster includes the base game and all three chapters of "The City That Never Sleeps" DLC, with updated character models, ray-traced reflections, improved lighting, performance mode options, and three additional suits.
138949.storyline: Eight years into his career as Spider-Man, Peter Parker has become a capable crime-fighter while struggling to balance his personal life. When a new villain threatens Marvel's New York, Peter's worlds as a civilian and a hero collide in ways that force him to look beyond himself to protect the city and the people he cares about.

142549.summary: Viewfinder is a puzzle game where you can reshape the world around you by taking photos with an instant camera.
142549.storyline: Viewfinder is an inventive first-person puzzle game built around a remarkable ability: to take photographs and two-dimensional images and place them into the world, where they become real, three-dimensional spaces the player can walk through and manipulate. This reality-bending mechanic serves a deeper story. The game is set inside a simulation created by a small team of researchers desperately working to solve an existential crisis: in the real world, all plant life on Earth has been wiped out, leaving humanity without a viable source of oxygen. The player character enters this digital space to retrace the scientists' steps, solving intricate photographic puzzles to reach the teleporters that carry them ever deeper into the experiment. Guiding them along the way is a witty artificial intelligence in the form of a cheshire cat named Cait. As the player pieces together the clues left behind, they begin to uncover what became of the research and the hopes riding upon it.

143249.summary: The Kostka is a mind boggling explorative coop puzzle featuring two main characters who just wanna get to the end.

143349.summary:
Nioh Remastered: Complete Edition is an enhanced version of the action role-playing game Nioh, developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo. Released in February 2021, this edition includes the base game along with all three DLC expansions:

- Dragon of the North: Adds new story content, regions, enemies, and gear centred around the warrior Date Masamune.
- Defiant Honor: Features new missions and a storyline focused on the siege of Osaka, introducing new characters and challenges.
- Bloodshed's End: Concludes the story of Nioh, adding further missions, enemies, and equipment.

The Remastered Complete Edition is optimised for next-gen consoles, offering improved graphics, faster load times, and support for 4K resolution and up to 120 FPS on compatible hardware.

147749.summary: Magical Maze is an engaging, fun game where you need to guide the coin from the beginning of the maze and up until the end. The way you play is you swipe the finger and then guide the coin towards the end. There are multiple different options, so you really have to figure out what works for you and what feature gives you the best value and experience here. Magical Maze comes with minimalist graphics, and you will get to experiment in multiple ways as you try to complete every level. With 10 levels and 270+ stages, there are always challenges to encounter, you just have to check it out and see how far you can go. Features: 10 levels, 270 stages to play through Endless level buildup Reload the level with a new solution Great, simple visuals

147849.summary: Test your skills in Mr Trials Compete in 50 amazing levels over 5 different worlds Beat the stunt score to receive the Golden Helmets Have you got what it takes?

152249.summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.
152249.storyline:
Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this third-person action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord, and thanks to your bold yet questionable leadership, you have persuaded an oddball crew of unlikely heroes to join you. Some jerk (surely not you) has set off a chain of catastrophic events, and only you can hold the unpredictable Guardians together long enough to fight off total interplanetary meltdown. Use Element Blasters, tag-team beat downs, jet boot-powered dropkicks, nothing’s off-limits.

If you think it’s all going to plan, you’re in for a world of surprises, with the consequences of your actions guaranteed to keep the Guardians on their toes. In this original Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy story, you’ll cross paths with powerful new beings and unique takes on iconic characters, all caught in a struggle for the galaxy’s fate. It’s time to show the universe what you’re made of.

You got this. Probably.

Your newly-formed band of legendary misfits is set to save the universe in this fresh but faithful take on the Guardians of the Galaxy. Somehow, you set off a chain of catastrophic events, leading to a wild ride through mind-blowing worlds inhabited by iconic and original Marvel characters. Turn up the all-star ‘80s mixtape and get ready to kick it.

180149.summary: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a musical adventure game in which Snufkin needs to restore the harmony of Moominvalley, after a series of grotesque parks has appeared and ruined the valley's natural balance. The game is an ambient and wholesome experience for both kids and adults, and combines open world-mechanics with puzzles, stealth and melodic elements.
180149.storyline: Based on Tove Jansson's beloved Moomins, Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley casts the player as the free-spirited wanderer Snufkin, returning to the tranquil Moominvalley he calls home. He finds the once-idyllic valley spoiled and dilapidated, its natural beauty disrupted, and discovers that his dear friend Moomintroll has gone missing, taken by the game's antagonist, the officious Park Keeper. Setting out to put things right, Snufkin journeys through the valley to restore it and to rescue his kidnapped companion. True to the gentle spirit of the Moomins, his adventure unfolds without violence; instead, Snufkin relies on his music, using melodies to interact with the world and its inhabitants as he explores. Along the way he encounters the valley's whimsical characters and gradually undoes the changes imposed upon their home. It is a quiet, dreamlike tale of a solitary traveler working to reclaim a peaceful place and reunite with the friend he cannot leave behind.

190249.summary: A 2d action-packed roguelike about an ape protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!

191849.summary: Become the best moonshiner there ever was, with accurate distillation methods recreated. Fermentation and distillation are simulated using exact formulas. Remember, nothing is illegal till you get caught!
191849.storyline:
We love moonshin’. There ain’t nothin’ better than good booze. In Appalachia, we know it well. We’ve got moonshine in our blood - in the case of some old-timers, maybe even literally. We love to talk about likker, make it, drink it all day long - and we love to share it too! How 'bout that, my gaming friend?

What’s your alcohol of choice? Do you maybe know how to make it? The process is a complex one, but with our know-how, we can shed some light on it, if you’d like; a little bit of moonlight - moonshine! - to guide you through the processes of fermentation, distillation, and bottling.

194249.summary: Formidable puzzles. Precise navigation. Balls. Simultaneous control. A fallen king…

197949.summary: GrimGrimoire OnceMore is a real-time strategy video game developed by Vanillaware and published by Nippon Ichi Software.
197949.storyline:
Lillet Blan was thrilled with excitement. She was invited to a Magic Academy where only the talented could enter. The legendary wizard and the headmaster of the Magic Academy, Gammel Dore, the one who defeated the Archmage. And the Silver Star Tower which is the school campus that once destroyed Archmage's castle. The tower was full of unsolved mysteries and dangers, and people who had their own speculations.

On the fifth day after Lillet opened her grimoire and began her path to becoming a wizard, a terrifying disaster struck the academy, and everyone in the tower is dead. Except for Lillet who had traveled back in time without knowing why... Will Lillet come closer to the truth by reliving the five days before the tragedy?

200449.summary:
Welcome to Off The Grid, the heart-pounding Extraction Royale where survival is just the beginning. Dive into a dark, cyberpunk world crafted by visionary director Neill Blomkamp (District 9) and prepare to augment, adapt, and dominate like never before!

Gear up with custom cyberlimbs and hundreds of weapon combos, modifying your body and arsenal mid-fight. Extract high-value loot, outsmart your enemies, and transform into a force of destruction. You’re not just fighting to survive—you’re fighting to be the last one standing.
200449.storyline:
Three global gaming giants have combined forces to craft the most intense, pulse-pounding experience ever conceived. This isn't just another shooter. This is the next evolution of cyberpunk warfare, imagined by visionary director Neill Blomkamp (District 9, Elysium), and it’s about to turn the genre upside down.

Gear up, Zero. Teardrop Island is waiting. This is more than a game. This is your chance to be part of something new, daring, and ground-breaking.

203449.summary: Clem is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy. A voice awakens you. It gives you purpose. To guide you, you find a notebook with mysterious entries and a house to explore.
203449.storyline: You awaken in a cold, dimly lit room, your senses slowly adjusting to the surroundings that, oddly, feel familiar. A strange sensation lingers in you, reminding you that something is not quite right. As you find your bearings, your attention is drawn to a peculiar item on the ground. A notebook labeled "CLeM" lies before you. As you delve into its pages, covered with intricate sketches of insects accompanied by vague symbols, you find a note containing a cryptic message: “Bring me BEAUTY.” Lost in deciphering the contents, a voice interrupts your focus.

204149.summary:
Last Time I Saw You is a coming-of-age narrative adventure about first loves and acceptance. An uplifting story, rich with complex characters, set in a vibrantly imagined vision of late 80s Japan.

Join Ayumi on an exciting tale of self-discovery in which he'll face his first tentative steps into adulthood and confront the terrible curse that has fallen upon his hometown.

207449.summary: Asteroid is an open world action adventure RPG set in space! Explore the universe to save planets, upgrade your ship and equipment, and defeat increasingly fearsome enemies!
207449.storyline:
The universe has changed: someone is trying to steal a mysterious power given by the gods to help a past civilization survive. Free the planets of hostilities and find out what is happening. During your journey, you may encounter many people willing to help you out, upgrade your ship and equipment, or even pay you to do some quests.
Asteroid's story mode is in constant development and each planet presents its own narrative arc.
With the addition of other planets, there will also be the introduction of a new chapter of the story mode.

210749.summary:
Join BIG S on his exciting journey through the kitchen and make him jump!
Enjoy the colorful comic graphics accompanied by atmospheric music.

211849.summary: 42 and more ways of using your own dead body in time travel. GOST of Time is an absurdist top-down action and puzzle game with time-traveling mechanics.

214249.summary: Pacmaga is 2D platformer with the goal of defending against waves of enemies and finally defeating the mighty Boss!

219049.summary: The clicking adventure you and your friends need. Eat grass with the main hero of the game The Capybara P and eat all the grass in the world!

221649.summary: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

224549.summary: Super Dark Deception is a fun retro take on the hit horror game, Dark Deception! This is the first chapter of the game and contains the first 4 levels. All future Super Dark Deception DLC chapters are included in the price. This means that once the game is purchased, CH2 & CH3 DLC content will be installed for free upon release.

228349.summary: Infinity Nikki, the fifth installment in the Nikki series by Infold Games. Step into a UE5-powered open-world styling fantasy filled with exploration, platforming, puzzles, and more. Travel across Miraland with Nikki and Momo, uncover hidden secrets, and use outfit abilities to overcome challenges and shape your style.
228349.storyline: In this game, Nikki and Momo embark on a new adventure to travel across the fantastical nations of Miraland, each with its own unique culture and environment. Players will encounter many characters and whimsical creatures while collecting stunning outfits of various styles. Some of these outfits possess magical abilities that are crucial for exploration.

231049.summary: Compete with your friends and smack 'em over the head in this physics-based galactic party game for up to four players!

237349.summary: A new game from the creators of Rabi-Ribi, embark on an epic action-adventure as you slash, dash, and combo your way through a sprawling land scarred by conflict. Explore and discover hidden secrets. Customize your build to triumph in spectacular boss fights and unravel the mysteries of the world in TEVI, a bullet hell metroidvania!
237349.storyline:
Welcome to Az, where our adventure begins. This sprawling continent is full of myth and magic, and is home to three main races: magic-wielding humans, animal-eared beastkin, and bio-mechanical hybrids called magitech. Az's unique blend of magical and technological advancements has shaped its long and storied past, from ancient civilizations to modern societies. However, conflicts between factions have scarred the land and its people. Despite this, the vast geography and diverse biomes of Az are teeming with life, both friendly and hostile.

Situated across the continent are five major cities: The palatial city of Ana Thema has long been the seat of human power, while the beastkin toil in the industrial hub of Morose. Beyond them lies the frozen tundra of Snowveil, the towering spires of Valhalla in the sky, and the dark depths of Tartarus. Each place in Az has its own secrets, mysteries, and stories to tell.

The heroine of the story, Tevi is a self-proclaimed genius engineer who sets out on a journey with her companions to uncover the truth about Astral Cogs, in order to assist her father's research.

243749.summary: Cricket 24 is the culmination of a decade of Cricket video game development and includes teams from every corner of the globe.

251949.summary: Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled ride in Stunt Paradise! Take on epic challenges, perform insane stunts, and experience extreme driving. Buckle up and play now!

252349.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

252849.summary: Welcome to the wildest kart racing event ever devised, where 60 players go bumper-to-bumper on outrageous circuits filled with power-ups. Avoid elimination and fight your way to the front of the herd in the scramble to be crowned champion!

272549.summary:
Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Dare you test your intelligence against a higher power? Featuring nine mind-stretching stages, plus a two player survival mode, 100 additional challenges and a custom-puzzle generator, Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks remains to this day a supreme test of mental and physical agility.

283949.summary: Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelite that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups, and a demonic blade. Journey through eight roguelite zones, save your friends, and take up arms against Omega Wing!

287849.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

292349.summary: Welcome to Caminora! Immerse yourself in the authentic police work of the American Highway Patrol. Solve cases, chase criminals and explore the open-world. Choose your officer and tackle the everyday life on the highways. Will you be able to maintain law and order?
292349.storyline:
Put on your uniform and step into the shoes of an American police officer with Highway Police Simulator! This game brings the heart-pounding action of the American Highway Patrol right to your fingertips. Immerse yourself in the unique challenges and serious police duties that officers face on a daily basis and truly feel what it's like to patrol the highways while maintaining law and order.

A compelling police story awaits you, with the option to play as either a male or a female officer. With both a casual and a simulation gameplay modes, Highway Police Simulator combines the best of both worlds: the freedom to drive and walk in an immersive virtual environment, and a diverse variety of exciting cases to solve in story-driven gameplay. Explore a diverse open world and tackle any situation that comes your way with an array of vehicles including cars, helicopters, and more.

Welcome to Caminora, where new missions await you! Get ready to experience the thrill of the chase, the satisfaction of solving crimes, and the adrenaline rush of patrolling the highways. What kind of cop will you be? Will you uphold the law with integrity, or will you bend the rules to get the job done? Your decisions will have a real impact on the story and the environment. Highway Police Simulator is where YOUR story begins!

293049.summary: Amazing Weekend: Search and Relax offers a variety of unique and compelling mini-games and hidden-object puzzles! Complete games to unlock new levels and explore interesting new locations where you'll go hiking, horseback riding, boating, and relaxing through a weekend of recreation!

304249.summary: "CRUELTY" is a Japanese-made splatter horror. You were in an accident and lost consciousness. The moment you wake up, you find yourself in a nightmare world, one that is not of this Earth. In an abattoir ruled by madness, horrific scenes unfold, and inescapable terror awaits you.

306049.summary: Experience the revival of a retro but timeless co-op action classic

314449.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.
314449.storyline:
When the old can no longer protect the land, the small must learn to carry the tune.

For as long as anyone can remember, a kind witch has cared for the forest and the creatures who call it home. But now, the world is beginning to fall out of harmony—and the witch who has always protected it is growing ill.

Her smallest familiars must venture beyond the shelter of home and learn to carry the responsibility that once belonged to her. Though she cannot join them, her magic is never far away—a gentle hand, ready to lift them back to safety.

Playing as a brave little mouse, you’ll journey through a vast world shaped by the beauty and wonder of Swedish nature, helping those you meet and restoring harmony one act of kindness at a time.

316849.summary: A small game where you control a rabbit escaping from the darkness that is chasing him. You need to jump on clouds to progress and use soap bubbles to jump even higher. During the game, you can encounter several types of power-up bonuses to gain a temporary advantage.

319749.summary:
A remaster of the original Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation, including The Times Exclusive Playable Level as well as the ability to toggle between original and remastered graphics.

Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

328449.summary: Lock, draw, and conquer. Claim your title as the ultimate Master of Bow!

334249.summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 collection.

342149.summary: In Penguin Flight: Beyond the Clouds, join the determined penguin on his quest to defy gravity! This 2D pixel art platformer offers challenging levels, creative obstacles, and high-flying action.

347849.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

348249.summary: What if your world was a lie? Outsmart inventive puzzles to escape the glitching simulation that holds you captive. Question reality and uncover a dark conspiracy while evading rogue security systems in this innovative puzzle-adventure.

367349.summary: Catch the best leaves for your tea! But wait, they have to ferment first. So you still have a chance to sort the leaves after catching.

367849.summary: Reflex Drop Time Race is a fast-paced arcade challenge where you control a square leaping from block to block, racing against time and testing your reflexes. Tap left or right to land on the correct side, collect time bonuses, and survive as long as possible. One wrong move — and it’s game over.

369849.summary: Experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 in an included separate game. Having once led a succesful startup company, he plunged himself into the dark world of the yakuza by choice after losing everything. Left with an empty heart, the pursuit to find true bonds drives him forward once again in a dramatic journey colored by exhilarating boxing-based combat, and a variety of engaging side experiences.

378149.summary: Marvel’s Spider-Man: The Great Web was a cancelled cooperative multiplayer project by Insomniac Games, designed as a live-service experience set in the Spider-Man universe. It would have allowed up to five players to control different Spider-Heroes across the multiverse, teaming up in missions against threats like the Sinister Six. Focused on character customization and shared gameplay, the game was shelved before its official announcement.

380649.summary: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

381249.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

382649.summary:
Space Invaders is an arcade video game developed by Tomohiro Nishikado and released in 1978. It is one of the earliest shooting games and the aim is to defeat waves of aliens with a laser cannon to earn as many points as possible.

This Arcade Archives edition emulates both black/white and colored versions with a combination of color filters and backgrounds mimicking the original arcade machines, along with VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support for smoother playback of the original frame rate.
382649.storyline: Invaders from outer space approach you and you have to eliminate them with your laser canon. The invaders arrive in waves - make sure you eliminate all of them before they reach you or destroyed you.

388249.summary:
Nekome: Nazi Hunter is a single-player, third-person action combat game where you step into the role of Vano Nastasu, a young Romani man consumed by grief after the brutal murder of his family by Nazi soldiers. The game follows Vano’s transformation from hunted to hunter as he embarks on a violent personal odyssey of revenge across war-torn Europe.

Nekome: Nazi Hunter approaches the Second World War from the personal perspective of Vano as he exacts revenge for the sadistic murders. You’ll scout enemy routes, plan your assault, and strike with precision in a mix of stealth and brutal up-close combat.

The game is inspired by grindhouse cinema and features visceral combat with grounded finishing moves, coming together in a symphony of violence where every encounter carries lasting consequences.

390849.summary:
Step into the arena where legends are forged in this breathtaking realistic gladiatorial RPG! Powered by Unreal Engine 5's cutting-edge technology, experience brutal combat and epic glory in stunning photorealistic detail.
From slave to legend, forge your path through treacherous gladiatorial schools and blood-soaked arenas. Master diverse fighting styles, earn the crowd's favor, and rise to become the most celebrated warrior in the empire.

391649.summary: Master puzzling stages with the help of your 2D feline companion!

392349.summary: Tankbit is a fast-paced endless arcade shooter where a cute green soldier rides a tiny tank into an ever-advancing battlefield.

393049.summary: You have six nights. The seventh day changes everything.

401449.summary:
Shadow Rose is a stylish puzzle adventure about two mysterious phantom thieves, Mysterious Mask X and Masked Beauty Z, infiltrating the Black Rose Auction House. Outsmart each room, manage your limited moves, uncover hidden treasures, and escape with elegance as the secrets behind the auction begin to unfold.

Play as Mysterious Mask X and Beauty Mask Z as they infiltrate an illegal auction to recover stolen and illegal treasures and relics. Plan every move carefully. One wrong step can make your escape impossible!

411149.summary: This construction bee will make never seen defenses.

414849.summary: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

414949.summary: Worms makes an explosive leap into tactical roguelike combat! Battle across destructible arenas, mod classic weapons and unleash devastating strategic combos as you fight for survival, riches and glory!

415149.summary: Greak 2 is a hand-drawn co-op metroidvania adventure. After fleeing their invaded world, siblings Greak and Adara find themselves in the hostile lands of Synoraz. Split in parallel dimensions, they must work together to save the last Storm egg before the ancient species is lost forever
